projects.title: Regression: actual persisted follow-up
projects.completeScope: Use the supplied checklist service adapter to create a trimmed title and independently read repository state. Return created/stored titles and whether the stored record matches. The missing-persistence mutation must produce a false decision. This is real local service/repository execution, not HTTP or the complete protected seven-contract harness. Preserve the original runtime oracle and learner TODO unchanged.

projects.title: Production evidence: fail/unknown/pass gate
projects.completeScope: Review the ten named evidence rows for your own project. In code derive FAIL if any required row fails, otherwise UNKNOWN if a required witness is unknown, otherwise a scoped PASS. DEPLOYMENT remains visible and nonblocking in this classroom policy. Row text is unverified student evidence; missing actual checks remain unknown, never invented pass.
